iWant: Squire to back up my folder every night and to fix what it can by itself before asking me to send a ticket
soThat: I lose nothing and rarely need help
description: The health check shown as a page, the Restart app, the nightly backup to iCloud Drive, and guided fixes from the known-fixes list.
title: Looks after itself: a nightly backup, and fixing itself first

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Squire owner's folder is backed up to iCloud Drive every night.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A file added to and a file removed from the Squire owner's folder since the last backup
acceptanceCriteria.then: The new file is copied into the iCloud backup folder, and the removed file is moved to a dated archive folder in the backup, never deleted.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Squire tries to fix a problem itself before anything else.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A fault the health check detects that has a fix on the known-fixes list
acceptanceCriteria.then: Squire applies the known fix, with the Squire owner's yes where the fix changes anything, checks that it worked, and offers no ticket; a ticket is offered only when the fix does not work.
